pages.text: The stars of this mod are of course the many differently-shaped $(#FF69B4)end rods$()!$(br2)By usage they fall into three groups:$(li)$(thing)Self-use$() — only usable on yourself$(li)$(thing)Others-use$() — only usable on other creatures$(li)$(thing)Both$() — anyone can take it. Very fair.$(br2)Every rod has its own personality — flip through the next pages and pick a favorite~

pages.title: Usage Counter
pages.text: Every rod faithfully counts how many times it has been used; hover over the item to check.$(br2)$(#FFB6C1)A well-read rod performs masterfully, meow~$()
